name: Domino Cocoa Patisserie
summary: A single bakery in cocoa and pistachio: a cream ground, cocoa ink and header, a pistachio accent, rounded photos and pill buttons, Cormorant over Jost; a top bar with the shop’s hours and contact, a centred italic wordmark drawn from the shop’s live title, the collections, search, a language and currency pill and the bag; a hero of collection names over photos, counters on a scalloped cocoa band, the best-selling collections, how ordering works, today’s selection, a marquee of the collections and the journal. Light by default, with a dark mode and the palettes in the footer’s Theme row.
